players.product: Circuit copper foil (Elecfoil) for AI accelerators and package substrates, incl. low-profile foil

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 354,046,661,102 (H1 2025: KRW 362,920,834 thousand) with an operating loss of KRW 21,876,790,670 (H1 2025 operating loss KRW 77,125,356 thousand); Q2 2026 revenue KRW 194,197,979,593 and operating loss KRW 16,896,328,507. Materials (Elecfoil) sales: domestic KRW 82,508M, exports KRW 283,079M; construction segment domestic KRW 47,872M, exports KRW 27,089M
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue KRW 354,046,661,102; operating loss KRW 21,876,790,670 (H1 2025 operating loss KRW 77,125,356 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: AI circuit-foil capacity: the board approved (2026-04-28) a circuit-foil expansion at Iksan Plant 1, investing about KRW 490 hundred million through November 2027, to respond pre-emptively to a sharp rise in demand for high-value circuit foil as the AI industry grows; a 16,000-ton line conversion to circuit foil is also under way for AI-related investment demand
quarterly_data.figure: about KRW 490 hundred million through November 2027; 16,000-ton line conversion

quarterly_data.signal: The company says demand for high-value circuit foil for AI accelerators and package substrates has risen sharply; it has successfully developed Elecfoil for AI accelerators, expects it to keep growing with the AI server market, and is developing low-profile copper foil for network AI accelerators to extend the line-up

Elecfoil nominal capacity 60,000 tons a year (Iksan and Malaysia plants); H1 2026 production 12,738 tons against 17,677 tons of operating capacity, utilisation 72.1% (FY2025: 47.4%). Malaysia is adding 50,000 tons a year (KRW 600,000,000,000 through 2028-12-31) for EV / ESS battery foil
quarterly_data.figure: utilisation 72.1% (12,738 of 17,677 tons); nominal capacity 60,000 tons a year

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration (customer not named in the note): one customer above 10% of H1 2026 revenue, Customer A KRW 172,506,275 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 126,269,738 thousand)
